legende_source: Figure 1. A real example of deep femoral vein thrombosis at the level of the upper left thigh (groin region). D1 shows the residual diameter of the non-compressible vein (i.e., the maximum diameter of the relative venous thrombus). D2 represents the venous diameter without compression.
